main_measure.name: slope of drift-adjusted 7-bar forward return on the forecast
main_measure.threshold: slope positive with t >= 2 to confirm (with the supporting check); negative with t <= -2 to reject; at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean drift-adjusted 7-bar return signed by forecast, day-clustered t >= 2

decided_by: Confirm: the slope is positive with t >= 2 and the signed drift-adjusted mean is positive with day-clustered t >= 2, over at least 30 cases.
reading: ER(30), the 7-day and 30-day returns are recomputed from each window's closes (ER = |close change over 30 bars| / sum of the 30 absolute daily changes); on bars without enough in-window history the detector's 'chop' regime and the sign of the raw scaled_week value stand in; the drift is the coin's mean 7-bar return on all grid bars of all its windows, the slope is a pooled OLS of drift-adjusted return on the forecast with its ordinary t, and the supporting t is a day-clustered t (deviations summed per day, G/(G-1) correction).

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0002943 on the check folds against +0.001235 on every fold
